You are invited to join the Weill Cornell Medicine community for a showcase of digital health innovations and technologies. This event is part of #AIWeekNY, a community-led festival organized by Pulse NYC that celebrates innovation across the AI ecosystem.

The following innovators and their AI-enabled technologies will be featured:

EmulatRx
An agentic AI platform that uses real-world patient data to support clinical trial design. Presented by Weishen Pan, PhD, Research Associate, Department of Population Health Sciences, Weill Cornell Medicine

WAV AI
An AI-based tool that analyzes sounds to detect fistula stenosis. Presented by Bobak Mosadegh, PhD, Associate Professor of Biomedical Engineering in Radiology and Director, Dalio Institute of Cardiovascular Imaging, Weill Cornell Medicine

Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction
An Epic-integrated clinical decision support tool that analyzes electronic health record data to identify pregnant patients at elevated risk for postpartum depression. Presented by Yiye Zhang, PhD, MS, Associate Professor of Population Health Sciences, Weill Cornell Medicine

Corneal Confocal Microscopy for Neurodegenerative Disease Detection
A noninvasive approach that uses corneal confocal microscopy to detect changes in the cornea’s small nerve fibers. Quantitative imaging and predictive analysis may offer an accessible biomarker for detecting and monitoring neurodegeneration. Presented by Rayaz A. Malik, MBChB, PhD, FRCP, Professor of Medicine, Weill Cornell Medicine–Qatar

We look forward to seeing you there!
